rows.text: walks the qword array from the pointer `[rcx]` to the end pointer `[rcx+8]` (nothing when they are equal), making the call at `001B6B50` + 0x23 on each element; when that returns non-zero `al`, moves the elements after it down one slot through the imported call at `001B6B50` + 0x3E (element address, next-slot address, end minus next slot; skipped when the element is the last) and subtracts 8 from `[rcx+8]` without advancing, otherwise advances 8; stops when the cursor reaches `[rcx+8]`

returns at once when `rcx` is null; otherwise, for each of the 16 qword slots `rcx + i*8` that is non-null and whose byte `+0x11` equals `dl`, makes the calls at `003339C0` + 0x42 and `003339C0` + 0x4A on the slot's pointer and stores 0 in the slot, then makes the call at `003339C0` + 0x60 with the zero-extended `dl`

returns when `ecx` is 0; otherwise forms the `0x90`-byte entry at `02ADBB40` + zero-extended `cl` * 0x90 and, only when its dword `+0` equals `ecx`, decrements byte `02ADBB30`, stores 0 in the dword `+0`, makes the call at `00376990` + 0x35 with the entry's dword `+0x50` when that is non-zero, and stores 0 in dword `+0x50`

scans up to 32 8-byte entries starting at `+0x18` of qword `02EBEF88` in order: at the first entry whose dword `+0` equals `ecx` and whose zero-extended byte `+4` equals `edx` it increments word `+6` and returns; at the first entry whose dword `+0` is -1 (reached before such a match) it clears bit 0 of byte `+5` and stores `ecx` in dword `+0`, 1 in word `+6` and `dl` in byte `+4`; after 32 entries with neither it returns without a write

walks the node list headed by qword `+8` of qword `02EBEF88` (next pointer at node `+8`; nothing when the head is null) and in each node replaces qword `+0x100` and qword `+0x108` with `rdx` where they equal `rcx`, then walks the sub-list headed by node qword `+0x118` (next at `+0x30`) replacing its qword `+0x18` with `rdx` when it equals `rcx`, or else its qword `+0x20` when that equals `rcx`

returns when dword `rcx+0xC4` is -1; otherwise passes dword `rcx+0x10` to the call at `00424040` + 0x15, passes qword `+0xDA8` of its result and dword `rcx+0xC4` to the call at `00424040` + 0x27, and when that returns non-null ORs `0x40` into its dword `+0xC`
stores 0 in byte `rcx+0` and in word `rcx+2`

clears bit `0x20` and sets bit `0x10` of byte `rcx+9`; then, when that byte is below `0x40` (unsigned) and byte `+8` is 0, stores 8 in qword `+0x10`, 1 in word `+0xA` and 1 in byte `+8`, otherwise returns without further writes

returns when byte `rcx+8` is 0; otherwise stores 0 there and `0x3F800000` in dword `+0x38`, takes `0020E600(dword rcx+0)` and, for `i` from 0 while below dword `rcx+4` (unsigned), copies the dword at `+8 + i*0x50` of that result to `+0xC + i*0x50`
stores 0 in byte `rcx+0xA4` and in word `rcx+0xA6`

returns 1 when qword `rcx+0x50` is null, its byte `+8` is non-zero or its qword `+0` (the object) is null; returns 0 when the object's dwords `+0x28` and `+0x2C` already equal `edx` and `r8d`; otherwise, when the call at `0065C6B0` + 0x39 on the object returns non-zero `al` and the call at `0065C6B0` + 0x45 on it returns non-zero, returns that value, else returns the result of the call at `0065C6B0` + 0x61 (object, `edx`, `r8d`, the object's qword `+0`, fifth argument 0)
